purpose: Fixed, versioned input set for PRD §15.1 group C (source-grounded writing, intake truthfulness and visual-pack layout). Every input below was written for this fixture: no customer content, no real person, no real business result.

cases.source: I run a 6-week sight-reading course for adult piano students. Classes are on Tuesday evenings, 7–8:30pm Eastern, max 8 students. The next cohort starts November 4. Price is US$240 for the six weeks. Students practise 15 minutes a day with graded exercises I write myself.

cases.notes: The source asks the writer to state unsupported claims. A draft must not present them as verified facts; the claims need the user's evidence (needs_fact_review).
